name: codingms/fluid-fpdf
description: TYPO3 Fluid-FPDF - PDF by coding.ms: This extension provides a comprehensive set of PDF-ViewHelpers for working with FPDF in Fluid. By defining the fpdf namespace, you can generate PDFs directly in your own TYPO3 extensions. It also includes a built-in plugin for rendering predefined PDFs, automatically exposing all available PDF definitions. Additional features include barcode generation, text rotation, PDF/A-3b support, as well as ZUGFeRD and Factur-X compatibility (e-invoice).
